block 0.1.6 (Steven Sheldon, https://github.com/SSheldon/rust-block)

The published package and the upstream repository (tag 0.1.6, revision
47178790cfc9d4a8b092051d8b413b78bd31254a, and the current default branch)
carry no license text. The package manifest declares:

    license = "MIT"
    authors = ["Steven Sheldon"]

Rustic relies on that declaration. block is linked only for Apple targets
(the Metal backend of wgpu-hal).
